description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a wrapper around GStreamer (gst) library functions, including a factory class for creating GstWrapper instances, and a GstWrapper class that provides methods to interact with GStreamer components such as plugins, elements, pads, buffers, and messages. It serves as an abstraction layer to facilitate GStreamer operations within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: GstWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing GstWrapper instances, implementing singleton pattern with thread safety.

classes.description: Implementation of IGstWrapper interface, providing methods to interact with GStreamer components and operations.
